lead: Your child drew the ending. Pim sends back a story card.
intro: Fill in a short form. Within {time}, a story card and ideas for your next talk come back by email. This is for grown-ups. We ask for a first name and an age, never a photo of your child.

Your email, your child's first name and age, and a few optional questions about your talk.

form.lead: Three short steps. Only the first one is required; you can skip the questions in step 2.
form.email: Your email (we send the card here)
form.name: Your child's first name

why.t: These questions are optional. Your answers help us write ideas that fit your child's story: what to ask next and how to keep the talk going. We use your answers once, to write your tips. We do not save them. We never use them to test, judge or diagnose your child, and we never share them. You can skip every question and still get a story card.

q.label: What did your child say about the place where the story happens?
How did your child think the main character felt?
How did your child feel at the start of the story, and at the end?
Why did your child choose this ending?
Did your child talk about a time they felt like this, or what they would do?

form.more: In your own words (optional, up to 300 characters)
form.c1: I am the child's parent or guardian, and I am over 18.
form.c2: You may use the first name and age to make the story card.
form.c3: You may use my answers once to write tips for our next talk.
form.c3Note: Needed only if you answered a question in part 2.
form.c4: You may share the story card (first name and age only) on Telning's Instagram and TikTok.
form.c4Note: Optional. We never share your answers or your email.
form.thanksH: Thank you! Pim is on it.

privacy.h2: What happens to what you send
p: Your email, your child's first name and age, and your answers go in one email to our small team. A person makes the card and writes your tips.
Your answers are used once, to write the tips. They are not saved in any database, file or statistics. The email is deleted after we reply, and in every case within 30 days.
If you let us share the card on Instagram or TikTok, we keep only the finished story card image, never your answers or your email.
We do not add you to the email list unless you ask for that separately.
Who touches the data: our website host ({host}), which receives the form, and {email}, which carries the email to our team. Nobody else.

items.a: A person makes every card. You get an email within {time}.

items.q: My child only scribbled. Does that count?
items.a: Yes. A scribble is a real ending at two or three years old. Pim loves scribbles.

items.q: Can I send more than one ending?
items.a: Yes, one form per ending. Pim answers every one.

items.q: Which languages do you write in?
items.a: English for now. The books have no words, so the story works in any language at home.

items.q: What do you do with my answers about the story?
items.a: We read them once to write your tips, then they are gone. They are never used to test, judge or diagnose your child, and never shared.
